name: Mingyue de Nü'er
source:
A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123130/Moon_Princess/] Steam [/url]]
translation:
融合武侠与神话色彩的女儿养成游戏——在波澜壮阔的武侠世界中将她培养成一代武林宗师！练武、战斗、经营，亲手塑造她的未来！超过50种分支结局与60余位剧情角色登场，培养独一无二的江湖侠女，改写整个武林的命运！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123130/Moon_Princess/]Steam[/url]]
